updates.quote: As of now, as we have mentioned, we expect year-on-year growth to continue slowly trending up towards 20% YoY, is what our current sense on the market is.
Irrespective of that, as we have mentioned in question 13, we now expect the losses to come down sequentially from here towards breakeven in the next four to six quarters.

new_promises.statement: Expect District business losses to reach breakeven in the next four to six quarters.
new_promises.quote: Irrespective of that, as we have mentioned in question 13, we now expect the losses to come down sequentially from here towards breakeven in the next four to six quarters.
new_promises.speaker: Akshant Goyal

new_promises.statement: Expect to deliver 30% CAGR in going-out NOV over the next three to four years.
new_promises.quote: For us to deliver 30% CAGR over the next three to four years, it doesn't necessarily mean that the industry has to grow that much.
new_promises.speaker: Akshant Goyal

new_promises.statement: Maintain $3 billion NOV guidance for going-out in FY30.
new_promises.quote: You've maintained your $3 billion NOV guidance for going-out in FY30, which would imply north of 30% CAGR over the next four years.
new_promises.speaker: Akshant Goyal
